messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable first-person shooter set in the streets of open-world New York City.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game with a raycast-rendered Manhattan street, enemy encounters, mission HUD, and responsive touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game interface, styling, and gameplay in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added WASD movement, sprinting, mouse look, shooting, reload, enemy attacks, health/ammo HUD, minimap, and mobile controls.
- Served and opened the game locally; captured and inspected gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Final verification after recent tweaks to horizon height, enemy placement, and mobile control visibility.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload the local browser page and inspect the latest gameplay screenshot.
2. Check for console errors and confirm mobile controls appear and work.
3. Summarize the finished game and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and HUD markup.
- `style.css`: Game visuals, layout, and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Rendering, controls, combat, and game state.

## Important Context
- Local dev server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Latest screenshot path: `/tmp/opencode/game-play.jpg`; it was captured before the final adjustments, so recapture to verify current visuals.
- Work is uncommitted.
